description.zh:
是否自动支付。

- 若传入`true`，请确保账户余额充足，否则会产生异常订单。
- 若传入`false`，您可以登录控制台，在**费用与成本**页面根据返回的订单号进行支付。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment.

- If set to `true`, ensure your account has a sufficient balance. Otherwise, an abnormal order is generated.

- If set to `false`, log on to the console. Then, go to the **Expenses and Costs** page to pay for the order using the returned order ID.
The ID of the cloud desktop.

description.zh: 优惠活动ID，可以通过询价接口获取命中的活动ID列表。
description.en: The promotion ID. Call a pricing inquiry API to get a list of applicable promotion IDs.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to get a list of supported regions for WUYING Workspace.

description.zh: 系统盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格为企业图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。
description.en: The performance level of the system disk. You can set the performance level for Graphics or High-frequency workspaces.

description.zh: 数据盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格为企业图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。
description.en: The performance level of the data disk. You can set the performance level for Graphics or High-frequency workspaces.

descriptions.zh:
创建云电脑时您可以通过创建自定义模板选择规格，其中企业图形型或高主频办公型默认采用ESSD云盘，支持设置磁盘容量和性能级别，您可以根据需要变更系统盘或数据盘的性能级别。

> 仅企业图形型和高主频办公型云电脑支持变更磁盘性能等级。
descriptions.en:
When you create a WUYING Workspace, you can define its specifications using a custom template. Graphics and High-frequency workspaces use Enhanced SSDs (ESSDs) by default, which lets you set the disk capacity and performance level. You can modify the performance level of the system disk or data disk as needed.

> Only Graphics and High-frequency WUYING Workspaces support modifying the disk performance level.
